boundary: No weights, model training, cloud resources or post-hoc favorable activation dataset. Official 8192 run separate from controlled boundary sweeps. All inherited files read-only.
conversion: Execute unchanged complete converter with storage and tokenizer-path redirection only; preserve first execution exception. Any continuation/subset is separately labeled. Compare scanner prompts and responses against actual converter outputs before interpreting count equivalence.
coverage: Reconcile 10092 raw candidates, 9412 parsed targets, 680 exclusions and 1070 mixed-unit parse failures. Measure empty-response and EOS supervision. Do not infer historical model performance.
eligibility: A fault counts only if executable variant produces a value differing from independent oracle on its assigned input family. Unmanifested mutations are excluded with reasons. Errors are errors, not detections.
oracle: For prediction index j, target index j+1 must be a retained response token, including EOS, and within unpadded retained sequence. Compare full loss-mask vector and token identity after the trainer's documented input_ids[:,1:] shift, not unshifted response coordinates. No model forward pass.
primary_question: Do implementation-coupled crop contracts reject manifested source faults, accept an executable repair and harmless source transforms, and distinguish unavailable evidence?
statistics: Exact outcomes on fixed source transformations and complete-data census; no population confidence interval over handcrafted mutants.
